quote.text: He poor, that stands in need of another, and hath not in himself all things needful for this life.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • True wealth in parenthood lies in nurturing the inner strength and self-sufficiency of our children, teaching them that they must cultivate all they need within themselves.
    • By modeling inner resilience and self-reliance, we empower our children to face life's challenges with integrity, thus ensuring that they never need to lean excessively on others.
  • Leadership:
    • Effective leadership requires fostering an environment where independence is prized; leaders must encourage self-development in themselves and in those they guide.
    • When leaders cultivate inner resilience and a sound inner life, their strength becomes a foundation that others can rely on, diminishing dependency on external validations.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, like in life, the most robust solutions come from building systems and products that are inherently complete and self-sufficient, minimizing reliance on constant external adjustments.
    • By focusing on creating value from within—be it through a strategy or design—product managers can ensure that their products stand strong in the market, resilient and resourceful on their own.
